modules.title: Population Genetics, GWAS & PRS Studio
modules.summary: Cohort QC, ancestry structure, association screening, regional review and polygenic-risk exploration in one reproducible workflow.
modules.purpose: Use genotype, phenotype and covariate data to identify quality problems, population structure and association candidates before specialist mixed-model validation.
modules.boundary: Exploratory screening does not replace validated PLINK, SAIGE or REGENIE pipelines, imputation, ancestry-matched validation or clinical interpretation.

modules.title: Pharmacogenomics & Clinical Genomics Studio

modules.boundary: Research-use output is not a prescribing recommendation. Clinical decisions require validated genotyping, current guidelines and qualified professional review.
